data.gender_notes: Arifin is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Arifin is an Arabic name that means 'knowledgeable' or 'wise'. It is derived from the Arabic word 'arafa', which means 'to know' or 'to be aware'. The name Arifin carries the meaning “Knowledgeable and wise” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Arifin usually hope their child will grow to embody knowledgeable and wise and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Arifin total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

data.cultural_impact: The name Arifin holds great significance in Islamic culture as knowledge and wisdom are highly valued attributes. The Prophet Muhammad (Peace Be Upon Him) once said, "The acquisition of knowledge is a duty upon every Muslim" (Bukhari, Muslim). This hadith reflects the importance of knowledge in Islamic society, and a person with the name Arifin is perceived as someone who embodies this virtue.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, Arifin signifies a seeker of knowledge and truth. It is believed that the pursuit of knowledge leads one closer to God, as knowledge is a means to gain a deeper understanding of His creation and His divine laws. The Prophet Muhammad (Peace Be Upon Him) said, "Seek knowledge even if it is in China" (Bukhari, Muslim). Thus, the name Arifin is not only a reminder of the importance of knowledge and wisdom in this world but also a reminder of the ultimate goal of seeking knowledge for the sake of Allah.
